1003-5006-5686-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Phyrexian Walker is starting in your graveyard.
1003-5006-5686-8170.description:
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Phyrexian Walker spell. Then, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker, creating a Blood token
Repeat.

4279-6634-7316--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-6634-7316--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Al Bhed Salvagers, Rat King and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Rat King ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2645-2872-3430-3756.easyPrerequisites: Clever Conjurer doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-2872-3430-3756.description:
Activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}{R}{R}{R} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, untapping Izzet Boilerworks
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Clever Conjurer.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

3430-3812-6723.easyPrerequisites: Simic Ragworm doesn't have summoning sickness.
3430-3812-6723.description:
Activate Simic Ragworm by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Simic Ragworm by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

147-5100-5686.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-5100-5686.description:
Cast Return Upon the Tide by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Return Upon the Tide.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, creating a Blood token.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Return Upon the Tide
Resolve the Return Upon the Tide copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

4687-4702-4929.notablePrerequisites: Cryptic Trilobite has at least four counters on it.
4687-4702-4929.description:
Activate Splinter Twin by tapping Gilder Bairn, producing its effect.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least three mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Cryptic Trilobite, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6972-7607-8095.easyPrerequisites: There are at least X land card(s) in all graveyards
6972-7607-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Centaur Vinecrasher.
When Centaur Vinecrasher dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

2146-3532-5078-7864.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Ravenhill Flock triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

129-1409-3755-7060.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

1445-2511-4871-7422.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2511-4871-7422.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control except Donatello

3259-7291-7295.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control an artifact creature.
3259-7291-7295.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Donatello and the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Donatello and Breath of Fury.
Resolve the Donatello trigger, creating a token copy of the artifact creature.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the artifact creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase

1492-5660-6010.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1492-5660-6010.description:
Cast Welding Jar by paying its mana cost.
When Welding Jar enters, Builder's Talent's second ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Resolve the Builder's Talent trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Welding Jar from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4699-5670-6291.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
4699-5670-6291.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Overgrowth Elemental triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Repeat.

292-2313-4968.description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Deathbringer Thoctar.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Deathbringer Thoctar.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
292-2313-4968.notes: You can remove counters to deal damage to creatures you control, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on them due to Rite of Passage.

1479-4288-5478-5700-5701.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-4288-5478-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Sarinth Greatwurm trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Sarinth Greatwurm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Sarinth Greatwurm triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Sarinth Greatwurm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Sarinth Greatwurm triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1322-3372-4050-6006.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if Enduring Vitality is not a creature
1322-3372-4050-6006.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {1}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

413-803-1238-2351-5467.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
When the Tentacle enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability
Repeat.

413-5853-5929.manaNeeded: {3}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
413-5853-5929.notablePrerequisites: You control no more than one Snail.
413-5853-5929.description:
Cast Wick either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Wick enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, if you control a Snail, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Snail, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Wick trigger, creating a 1/1 Snail creature token.
When the Snail enters the battlefield as a Rat due to Leyline of Transformation, Wick and Blasting Station trigger.
Repeat from step 3.

3652-4452-5852.notablePrerequisites: Rukarumel on the battlefield with "Sliver" chosen
3652-4452-5852.description:
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}, and choosing to pay its replicate cost an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}.
Ornithopter triggers, creating a copy of it for each time its replicate cost was paid.
Resolve all Ornithopter spells, causing the nontoken Ornithopter to enter the battlefield, and creating a token copy of it for each time its replicate cost was paid.

2178-2292-5698.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Ulamog's Dreadsire.
Ulamog's Dreadsire does not have summoning sickness.
2178-2292-5698.description:
Activate Ulamog's Dreadsire by tapping it, creating a 10/10 Eldrazi creature tokens.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Eldrazi token.
When the Eldrazi token dies, Ulamog's Dreadsire triggers, untapping Ulamog's Dreadsire.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

144-2292-5434.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2 greater than the largest life total among your opponents.
144-2292-5434.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix.
When Ashcloud Phoenix dies, its first ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix.
Yarus' second ability triggers, returning Ashcloud Phoenix from your graveyard to the battlefield face down, and then turning it face up.
Ashcloud Phoenix's second ability triggers, dealing 2 damage to each player.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

575-2139-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Ire Shaman, adding {R}.
When Ire Shaman dies, Yedora triggers, returning Ire Shaman from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Ire Shaman by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Ire Shaman's morph ability by paying {R}, turning it face up.
Ire Shaman triggers, exiling the top card of your library with the ability to play it this turn.
Repeat.

803-1219-4221-4438-4499.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five lands, plus additional lands that do not have summoning sickness and can tap to produce at least {3}.
"Cleric" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-1219-4221-4438-4499.description:
Activate Ancestor's Prophet by tapping five lands you control, causing you to gain 10 life.
Activate any number of other lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Activate Beledros by paying 10 life, untapping all lands you control.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Beledros.
Repeat.
If the additional lands can tap to produce at least {4}, this combo nets infinite mana.

1651-3129-4259-4659.description:
Activate Collector's Vault by paying {2} and tapping it, causing you to loot and create two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Treasures, untapping Collector's Vault.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Treasure, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

3385-4221.description:
Whenever a land enters the battlefield, it enters as a 1/1 creature due to Living Plane.
Aether Flash triggers, dealing 2 damage to the land.
The land dies as a state-based action due to having less than zero toughness.

1837-3903.description:
Whenever a player casts a spell from their hand, Knowledge Pool triggers, exiling that spell.
Because Arcane Laboratory prevents players from casting more than one spell each turn, players cannot cast the spell permitted by Knowledge Pool, or any other spell that turn.

678-1379-4497-4853.notablePrerequisites: Slobad does not have summoning sickness.
678-1379-4497-4853.description:
Activate Slobad by tapping it and sacrificing Dross Scorpion, adding {R}{R}{R}{R} that can only be spent to cast artifact spells or to activate abilities of artifacts.
Dross Scorpion dies, triggering itself and Enduring Renewal.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Slobad.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Dross Scorpion from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Dross Scorpion by paying {4}.
Repeat.

339-1995-2713.notablePrerequisites:
Gauntlets of Light attached to Jegantha.
Jegantha does not have summoning sickness.
339-1995-2713.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Jegantha by paying {W}, untapping it.
Repeat.

643-1303-2743-4499.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Biovisionary.
Necroduality triggers, creating a token copy of Biovisionary.
Repeat steps 1-2 two additional times.
At the beginning of your end step, Biovisionary triggers, causing you to win the game.

907-1479-3703.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
907-1479-3703.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it, Sporemound, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sporemound trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it and Sporemound trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1872-5003.description:
Activate Composite Golem by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Nim Deathmantle triggers.
Composite Golem dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Composite Golem from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

341-985-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat
